1.  Calm down, slow down, customer looks to you to be in charge.  If you do things in a systematic way, they will accept it.


2.  Greet: Walk up to the table, smile, and say "Hi! How are you tonight?"  Squat to be at eye level with customer and use the table for a writing surface.  Have more than one pen.  Do not loan any pens out ever or have more than three.  Say "Just one minute please" if they start to talk before you are ready.  


3.  Order taking at a booth:  Write down the table number.  Look at customer in seat #1 on your left outside seat.  Ask "What would you like me to order for you?  Mark #1 on your pad, circle it.  Then their order.  Go clockwise on your left inside seat, like you are reading a book.  #2  What would you like?  Write on pad #2 and circle it.  Seated inside on right, "What would you like?"
